name: Aurum Family
source:
[i]"Be drowned in clean water to clean yourself of your sins, burn to shave off your dishonest tissue, consume Lysergsäure to enlighten your soul, starve so you can reach your rawest mental state. When your physical body weakens, the more your mind strengthens."[/i]

Such reads a passage in the diary of Arsène, the recently brutally murdered member of an infamous religious sect - now suspected cult - in your town. Read his diary to find out what caused his gruesome death.

[From [url=https://lothaine.itch.io/aurum-family]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]“用干净的水淹死自己，以洗清自己的罪孽；烧死自己，以剃除不诚实的组织；喝Lysergsäure来启迪你的灵魂；挨饿，这样你才能达到最原始的精神状态。当你的身体衰弱时，你的思想就会变得更加强大。”[/i]

这是阿尔塞纳日记中的一段话，阿尔塞纳是你镇上一个臭名昭著的宗教派别（现在被怀疑是邪教）的成员，最近被残酷谋杀。阅读他的日记，找出导致他惨死的原因。

[来自[url=https://lothaine.itch.io/aurum-family]itch.io[/url]]
